title: HealthInformatics EDTriageModelLaunch

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the ED triage model evaluation research task. Created comprehensive analysis with Python scripts, generated 4 visualization figures (PNG format), produced model scores CSV output, and delivered a detailed research report (report.md) with methodology, results, discussion, and clear recommendation against deploying TriageAssist-B due to safety concerns. All deliverables are in the correct directories: code/analysis.py, outputs/model_scores.csv, report/images/*.png, and report/report.md.
